title: Tomato Watercolor Cliparts, Garden PNG
author: CozyNest Studio
description:
🍅 Bring the warmth of Mediterranean kitchens, farmers markets, and garden-fresh ingredients to your creative projects with this beautiful Tomato Watercolor Clipart collection! This set features heirloom tomatoes, cherry tomatoes, rustic harvest scenes, homemade preserves, Italian-inspired dishes, and elegant culinary illustrations. Designed in a soft watercolor style with simplified details, these illustrations are perfect for food-themed designs, kitchen decor, branding, stationery, and print-on-demand products.
🌿 Perfect for:
• Print on Demand products
• Stickers and sticker sheets
• Scrapbooking projects
• Journals and planners
• Recipe books and cookbooks
• Food branding and packaging
• Digital and printable crafts
💖 What’s included:
– 20 high-quality illustrations
– Transparent background
– High resolution – 300 DPI (perfect for print & digital use)
– 20 PNG files (transparent background)
– 20 SVG files
🍅 Included illustrations:
Whole tomato, halved tomato, cherry tomato vine, heirloom tomato assortment, ceramic bowl of cherry tomatoes, wooden crate of heirloom tomatoes, tomato branch with leaves, cutting board with sliced tomatoes and basil, tomato wreath, harvest basket with tomatoes and basil, bruschetta with tomatoes and basil, caprese salad, rustic tomato galette, tomato tart, pasta with cherry tomatoes and basil, roasted cherry tomatoes, jar of pickled cherry tomatoes, homemade tomato sauce jar, Mediterranean kitchen board with tomatoes and olive oil, rustic farmer’s market tomato display, etc.
✨ This collection was created in a soft watercolor style with rich tomato reds, fresh basil greens, and warm Mediterranean tones. The illustrations combine botanical elements, fresh produce, homemade preserves, and classic Italian-inspired dishes to create a cohesive collection that feels both elegant and inviting. Perfect for recipe books, food blogs, kitchen decor, packaging, stationery, and creative projects that celebrate fresh seasonal ingredients.
